titles.romaji: Megumi to Taiyou II: Kajuu Gummi Tweet Mystery - Kieta Sapphire Roman no Nazo
titles.native: メグミとタイヨウII 果汁グミ Tweet Mystery 消えたサファイアロマンの謎

description:
The "Megumi and Taiyou II" commercial centers on the mystery of Taiyou's missing "Sapphire Roman"—a seedling for grapes of "legendary" taste.

(Source: Anime News Network)
